title: Cosmic Portal Duel
description: In a frozen, cracked ice landscape under a starry nebula sky, a man in dark clothing runs toward a massive glowing circular portal inscribed with runes while a female figure with a crescent moon headdress stands on a snowy outcrop holding a staff and sword. A large dragon-like shadow is cast across the ice in the foreground.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene on a fractured ice plain under a vibrant purple and blue nebula sky. A man in black runs toward a giant luminous circular portal filled with glowing runes and a bright central light. To the right, a powerful sorceress with a crescent moon crown stands on a snow-covered rock holding a staff and sword. A large menacing dragon shadow stretches across the ice. Epic lighting, cinematic composition, highly detailed digital art.
